lines.2: ...Damn. I forgot the day she was coming back.
lines.5: 「Don't mind if I let myself in.」
lines.6: 「Leo! I'm back, and I brought my smile! Grovel in gratitude for your souvenir...」
lines.7: 「Huh? That idiot isn't here. In the bathroom?」
lines.12: 「That's my line! Why are you here?!」
lines.15: 「I see... You came in through the upstairs window.」
lines.17: 「What?! Screw you! Why are you acting like this is your house?」
lines.18: 「We childhood friends always come in through the upstairs window. Leo knows that.」
lines.19: 「But someone who's barely known Leo wouldn't understand.」
lines.20: 「Huh? Are those Leo's clean boxers in your hand?」
lines.21: 「Chains and razors suit you. Domestic things like this don't.」
lines.24: 「You think acting tough scares me? That delinquent routine is tired.」
lines.30: Are they playing tug-of-war with my boxers?
lines.32: I force my way between them.
lines.36: I'd forgotten after all her recent affection, but this is how she normally treats other people.
lines.37: 「For now, let's just... calm down, okay?」
lines.40: For now, I sent both of them home.
lines.42: But I have to talk Kinu down.
lines.44: 「Kinu's mad and won't listen to me.」
lines.45: 「I thought she might listen to you.」
lines.46: 「I'd do anything for you, but this is a lousy assignment.」
lines.51: 「'Do whatever you want.' She's sulking and says she won't come through the second floor anymore.」
lines.53: 「All right. I'll handle it myself from here. Thanks, Subaru.」
lines.56: 「Whose food is better, Yashi's or mine?」
lines.59: 「Only assuming both are delicious! Your cooking is plenty good too...」
lines.60: 「I'll cook for you again. Compare them.」
lines.61: Why is he competing with her?
lines.65: 「...But I still think Nagomi's is better.」
lines.69: The childhood gang makes everything more complicated.
lines.70: 「Sorry I sent you home early on Sunday, Nagomi.」
lines.72: 「Kinu says she won't barge in anymore.」
lines.75: Even mentioning Kinu is a bad idea.
lines.76: They can't stand each other, though I think they make a good pair.
lines.77: 「...I'll give you extra attention today to make up for it.」
lines.80: Nagomi clicks the window lock shut.
lines.84: 「...Kinu said I've barely known you at all...」
lines.85: 「I've known them since we were kids.」
lines.87: 「I'm frustrated that I don't know your childhood either.」
